name: tekla-mcp
description: Work with the Tekla Structures model open on this computer: read, analyze, draw, and edit after a preview.

interface.shortDescription: Work with the open Tekla Structures model
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local Tekla MCP server: one server per installed Tekla version, each with its own switch. Read and analyze the open model and its drawings, look at pictures of it, and run checked C# scripts. Every change is previewed first and applied only on request.
defaultPrompt: Check the Tekla connection and summarize the model
Group the steel weight by profile and material
Find modeling issues in the selected parts
